posts:
Foreign intelligence plots targeting journalists on foreign soil face the full weight of judicial accountability.
Evidence: Court convictions, surveillance proof, Iranian handler links
#Aletheia #UK #Security 🌐

Two men are convicted in the UK for carrying out surveillance on exiled journalists as part of an Iranian assassination plot.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Productive Justice

Official court records and police investigations confirm active foreign state-backed reconnaissance aimed at intimidating and harming UK dissidents.
Resulting Judgement: (+0.9, +0.9) — Institutional Defense

Verdict: PASS — Small Fall from Grace.
Thorough police work and judicial prosecution successfully neutralized a transnational security threat.

Integrity: Absolute Truth (Hypocrisy: 1.0, z: 1)

- Mostafa Sepahvand & Farhad Javadi Manesh: FAIL (-2.0, -2.0) — Executed hostile foreign surveillance against journalists.
- UK Counter-Terrorism Police: PASS (1.5, 1.5) — Uncovered and prosecuted transnational operatives.
Mostafa Sepahvand and Farhad Javadi Manesh conducted extensive surveillance between 2024 and 2025 before being intercepted and convicted by British courts.

The Bright Side:
Swift counter-terrorism intervention prevented physical harm to targeted journalists on British soil.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Focusing on operational tactics (HOW) rather than geopolitical statecraft (WHY).

Social Physics Analysis:
A clear case of state-sponsored extraction meeting robust institutional defense, where transparent police work dismantles covert foreign interference.

The Trajectory: The Path of Small Fall from Grace.
Exposing and prosecuting covert hostile operations moves society from dangerous vulnerability toward restored security. Mathematical vector confirms high systemic alignment.

The Unavoidable Truth: Authoritarian states actively use proxy networks to silence dissidents abroad.

The Unavoidable Lie: Covert operatives hired via social media leave no digital or physical traces behind.

Alethekanon:
When foreign powers export violence across borders, open legal systems provide the ultimate shield for free expression.

Awwthekanon:
It is terrifying to think journalists have to fear for their lives at home, but thank goodness investigators stopped this plot in time.

Brothekanon:
Absolute wild that people get recruited off social media to run hits. Good thing MI5 and the cops were on it.

Spirithekanon:
"Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity." Psalm 64:2 PASS
Transparency and justice protect the vulnerable from hidden conspiracies in the dark.

Two men found guilty of helping Iran try to ‘eliminate’ UK-based journalists

Mostafa Sepahvand and Farhad Javadi Manesh carried out surveillance in an effort to inflict violence on targetsTwo men of Iranian origin who were hired through social media as part of a plan to “eliminate” journalists in the UK have been found guilty of assisting Tehran’s intelligence services.Mostafa Sepahvand, 41, and Farhad Javadi Manesh, 46, carried out surveillance and reconnaissance between August 2024 and March last year in an attempt to inflict violence on “subjects” in the UK.
